```plato
//==
// # ISurface patches and control nets
//
// The rectangular surface pieces: corner-interpolated and control-net patches
// (Bezier, B-spline, NURBS), the flat and spherical windows, and the Coons blend
// of four boundary curves (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Parametric_surface).
// Control nets use Array2D with the U direction along columns and the V
// direction along rows. Evaluation lives in `surfaces.library.plato`.

//==
// # Patches and control nets

// The bilinearly interpolated patch over four corner points: the simplest
// curved quadrilateral surface
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bilinear_interpolation).
type BilinearPatch
    implements IParametricSurface, IDeformable3D
{
    P00: Point3D;
    P10: Point3D;
    P01: Point3D;
    P11: Point3D;
}
```
